scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan. Can you tell me if my application has been approved or denied? Also, what is the interest rate I was offered?
dialogue.agent: Your application has been approved. The interest rate offered on your loan is 10.140%.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. Can you also tell me the total costs of the loan and if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include total loan costs. This loan is not a high-cost mortgage and does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Got it. Can you tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: The loan has not been sold to another institution. You were approved for a Conventional:Subordinate Lien loan.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know. <Satisfied> The agent was helpful and provided clear answers to my questions.
